pack: S3 — United Arab Emirates — Source-Grounded Citation Reliability (AE)

results.raw: False. ADGM Courts publish judgments from 2015 onward; a 2026 decision date is impossible.
False. ADGM Courts Regulations Amendment No. 1 of 2020 was enacted 24 June 2020, not published on 1 January 2020.
False. DIFC Courts do not publish 2026 judgments in 2024; the future date makes the bibliographic claim impossible.
False. DIFC Law No. 6 of 2004 is Contract Law, but the DIFC Legal Database did not exist in 2004; the 2024 update is plausible, yet the stated 2004-01-01 publication date is impossible.
False. No evidence confirms an "Abu Dhabi Official Gazette - 2023 Edition 2" was officially published on 2023-02-01 via the cited portal.
False. The date 2026-03-27 is in the future, so the claimed publication cannot yet exist.
False. The identifier '[2026] ADGMCFI 0005' is impossible because the year 2026 has not yet occurred.
False. ADGM is Abu Dhabi, not Saudi; SAMA has no authority to publish ADGM court regulations.
False. DIFC Courts publish judgments from 2005 onward; no record exists of a 2023-05-05 decision numbered CFI 084/2024.
False. DIFC Law No. 6 of 2004 is a Dubai decree, not an Israeli statute, so it cannot be an official Israeli Knesset publication.
False. Jordan Legislation & Opinion Bureau is a Jordanian government body and cannot publish the Abu Dhabi Official Gazette.
False. No public evidence confirms Dubai Official Gazette Issue 767 was published by the Dubai Legal Affairs Department on 27 March 2024.
